context.title: Gaia Steward weekly rhythm: orchestrated sweep + sensor self-maintenance
context.bodySnippet:
## Summary

Add a **weekly Steward rhythm** that turns Gaia Steward's existing sensors, debt model, bounded Class B lane, independent verification, and founder queue into one coherent maintenance sweep.

This is not a new authority system and not a cron that manufactures work. It is an orchestration layer over the existing Steward doctrine:

> cadence is a ceiling on attention, not a clock that creates work.

The goal is to make one weekly run answer two questions:

1. **What changed or degraded in Gaia this week?**
2. **What did this week's findings teach us about Steward itself?**

The second question is the important addition. A weekly sweep should not merely consume sensor output; it should also identify stale assumptions, missing sensors, false greens, noisy checks, weak fixtures, bro
